details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 15, 187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Issue-mode cleanup is deferred until after Step 1 reads the plan, but Step 1 has no operational instruction to invoke it, so the stopped stage session may remain unarchived.
  WHY: The reviewers identify no trigger after plan resolution; the cleanup needs the `Source issue:` identifier available only then.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup header says every stage session runs cleanup in Step 0, contradicting the issue-mode instruction to defer it until after Step 1.
  WHY: The conflicting timing instructions may lead a session to run cleanup before the plan's `Source issue:` identifier is available or to defer it without executing it.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:103, 108, 161, 190-191 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Reviewers disagree about whether rename and label-read failures have a durable operator-visible error surface.
  WHY: The highest reported severity is MAJOR; Gemini says failures can leave the session unarchived without a durable marker, while DeepSeek says the rename retry/fallback and label-read reporting already define these paths and calls the concern a false positive.
- tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:245-260 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The contract test checks text presence but does not pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger's placement relative to Step 1.
  WHY: The test could continue to pass if the operational cleanup timing regressed.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 192 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Skipping issue-mode cleanup when the plan has no `Source issue:` line is not instructed to be logged or reported.
  WHY: The reported output may not distinguish an intentional skip from cleanup that was silently dropped.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:107 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fallback does not specify what to do if both the session-title rename and the blocker-comment update fail.
  WHY: In that case, the old title and missing comment may leave no operator-visible marker for the unarchived session.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:107, 190 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup selector's `— blocked on issue` suffix is not contractually protected against a future working stage title matching it.
  WHY: The reviewer says such a match could cause the cleanup to archive an actively working session.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The cleanup must actually fire on a `/reclarify` resume, after Step 1 reads the plan and the `Source issue:` identifier is available.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, Step 1; workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Step 1 (lines 15-16) ends with instructions for issue-mode plan resolution and contains no reference to the Zombie-checker cleanup; the cleanup-section header at line 187 reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up:"; the new Step 0 child bullet at line 12 says "once step 1 has read the plan, run the Zombie-checker cleanup too" but provides only a textual deferral with no operational hook at the end of Step 1. GLM assessed the deferral as a clear instruction that a capable model follows and considered the header imprecision non-blocking.
- requirement: The contract test must pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger to run after Step 1 reads the plan, not merely assert text strings exist.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions (lines 245-260) only checks text-string existence and does not assert that Step 1 invokes the cleanup or that the cleanup-section header distinguishes issue-mode timing. GLM assessed the existing test as following the standard pattern for command-file contract tests.
- requirement: scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py must be documented in docs/INVENTORY.md or explicitly exempted so the lint check passes and the PR can merge.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section (or tests/inventory_exemptions.txt)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini says the PR diff does not touch docs/INVENTORY.md and tests/inventory_parity.py continues to fail; DeepSeek says docs/INVENTORY.md line 129 already contains `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py — Catch-all sweep: queue a fresh Claude fixer (/fix-claude-pr) for claude/* PRs whose fix is overdue with no live claim` and the lint check passes on head 0cafcce. GLM also reports the entry is present and `failed_count: 0`.
- requirement: When Step 1 reads a plan that lacks a `Source issue:` header line, the issue-mode cleanup must log or report the skip so an operator can distinguish a project-mode resume from cleanup that was silently dropped.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md; workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The new Step 0 bullet at line 12 says "a plan without that line skips this" but never instructs the session to log or report the skip. The cleanup-section report line at line 192 only fires when `m` is computable.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: line 12 (Step 0 bullet "Issue-mode resume without a — resume. block") and line 190 (cleanup sub-bullet "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions")
  severity=NIT
  confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rename-failure path (line 107) and label-read-failure path (line 190) already define handling explicitly.
  WHY: No runtime failure; rename retry/fallback and label-read failure reporting are present on head 0cafcce, so the earlier concern is a false positive.
- tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py
  Line or code reference: lines 245-260, test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions
  severity=NIT
  confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test checks text strings but does not pin zombie-checker cleanup trigger placement relative to Step 1.
  WHY: A future change could remove the deferral or alter cleanup timing while the test still passes.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description says "Issue Mode → Stops" and the changelog says "That cleanup now also runs on an issue-mode resume without a — resume. block". For the cleanup to actually run on a /reclarify resume, it must be invoked after Step 1 reads the plan, because the cleanup predicate needs the Source issue: identifier from the plan header, which is only available after Step 1's Read.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, Step 1 (line 15, after "Read it in full") — an explicit instruction to invoke the Zombie-checker cleanup when the plan header carries a Source issue: line. Alternatively, the Zombie-checker cleanup section header at line 187 must explicitly state that issue-mode cleanup runs after Step 1 reads the plan rather than in Step 0. The byte-identical twin in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md carries the same defect.
  Evidence of absence: Step 1 (lines 15-16) ends with instructions for issue-mode plan resolution and contains no reference to the Zombie-checker cleanup. The cleanup-section header at line 187 reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up:" — with no exception for the issue-mode deferral described at line 12. The new Step 0 child bullet at line 12 says "once step 1 has read the plan, run the Zombie-checker cleanup too" but provides only a textual deferral with no operational hook at the end of Step 1. An unattended session following the step-by-step order enters Step 2 without ever returning to run the cleanup that Step 1 was supposed to trigger. The stopped — blocked on issue session stays unarchived — the same bug the PR was meant to fix.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The contract test (the PR description says "tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py: a new contract test") must pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger to run after Step 1 reads the plan, not merely assert text strings exist.
  Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py — extend test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions (or add a sibling test) to assert that Step 1 references the cleanup invocation, or that the cleanup-section header at line 187 explicitly carves out issue-mode timing from the step-0 invariant.
  Evidence of absence: test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions (lines 245-260) only checks text-string existence: the title suffix, bullet headers, label predicate, self-exclusion clause, working-bucket skip, Source issue: plan-header references, rename-failure fallback, label-read-failure path, and title-collision check. It does not assert that Step 1 invokes the cleanup or that the cleanup-section header at line 187 distinguishes issue-mode timing. None of the other tests in the module reference the new bullet, sub-bullet, or blocked-on-issue title. A future edit that re-orders the bullets, drops the deferral text, or revises line 187 to remove the step-0 timing exception could still pass unchanged.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py must be documented in docs/INVENTORY.md or explicitly exempted so the lint check passes and the PR can merge.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section (or tests/inventory_exemptions.txt)
  Evidence of absence: Already satisfied on the current head. docs/INVENTORY.md line 129 contains `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py — Catch-all sweep: queue a fresh Claude fixer (/fix-claude-pr) for claude/* PRs whose fix is overdue with no live claim`. The merge of main into this branch brought the entry in. The pass-1 consensus finding flagged on this point is stale — it applied to an earlier head before the merge of main. The lint check passes on head 0cafcce.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5 (already fixed — the concern is a stale false positive)
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
